CreateDocumentParamsRequest.description: Accepted keys: file_name (required; the document name, up to 255 characters), optional team_id (numeric team space id; omit for the personal space) and optional theme_id (numeric id from getthemes; unknown ids are rejected). The new document has one default title slide. The response carries the resource id to use as presentation_id in every other tool.

file_name.description: Name given to the new presentation, up to 255 characters. Letters, digits, spaces, common punctuation and non-Latin characters are accepted. Mandatory.

theme_id.description: Id of the theme applied to the new presentation, which sets its colors, fonts and slide layouts. The default theme is used when omitted.

team_id.description: Id of the team workspace the presentation is created in. The caller's default team is used when omitted.

file_name.description: New name for the presentation, up to 255 characters. Mandatory.

remove_comments.description: Whether to leave the source presentation's comments out of the duplicate. Comments are carried over when omitted.

new_name.description: Name for the duplicate, up to 255 characters. The source presentation's name with a copy suffix is used when omitted.

password.description: Password to protect the downloaded file with. Supported for pptx, ppsx and pdf only.

format.description: Format to export to: pptx, ppsx, ppt, pps, odp or pdf. Mandatory.

version_id.description: Resource version of the presentation to export. The current version is exported when omitted.

resource_ids.description: Comma-separated ids of the presentations to act on, each a 37-character alphanumeric string. Mandatory.

post.summary: Create a new, empty presentation named file_name, optionally inside a team (team_id) and with a theme (theme_id, a numeric id from getthemes - resolve the user's theme choice there first). Every new presentation contains one default slide at index 0 whose placeholders inherit geometry and style from the theme; use it as the first slide with createSdkPresentationSlidesPopulate and insert further slides from index 1. Returns the resource id, which is the presentation_id every other tool takes. When the slide content is already known, createPresentationFromContent creates the deck and its slides in one call.

get.summary: List the caller's presentations: type 0 owned (default), 1 shared with me, 2 trashed; page with from (0-based, default 0) and count (0 to 50, default 20); sort with sort_by (0 created time, 1 last modified - the default, 2 last opened, 3 last modified) and ascending (default false). fields restricts the returned columns. Each entry's resource_id is the presentation_id for the other tools. An account with no storage yet returns an empty list with a message. Read-only.

post.summary: Upload one presentation file into the default library, import it, and return the imported presentation in the same response
post.description: Upload one presentation file into the default library, import it, and return the imported presentation in the same response. A password-protected file needs password: without it, or with a wrong one, the call answers 400 and the upload is discarded, so send the file again with its password. As on the web, an upload whose conversion fails stays in the library, and the error names its resource_id and import_id.
